Lessons.Title: Finding Unknown Coordinates on a Circle
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Use sine and cosine to find coordinates of points on a circle in all 4 quadrants.
A point on a circle radius r at angle θ from the positive x-axis has coordinates (r cosθ,r sinθ). Quadrant signs and scale must both be applied.
